ac5_rollback.gateway_restart_note: Production rollback needs `hermes gateway restart` (config read at boot). The probe substituted one explicit dispatcher pass because restarting the gateway would kill this very job; production step is documented in the runbook.

findings.title: Gateway dispatcher enumerates every non-archived board
findings.detail: gateway/run.py::_kanban_dispatcher_watcher -> _tick_once calls list_boards(include_archived=False) and dispatch_once per board every tick. A new board is claimed by the gateway on the next tick, so 'test board unknown to the gateway' is NOT an isolation mechanism (attempt A: card t_70c911ff was claimed by hermes:994636, lock of the gateway). Mitigated for this probe by setting board.json archived=true; documented in the runbook.

findings.title: RAM target band not reproduced
findings.detail: Peak VmHWM 152-164 MB vs. 0.4-0.6 GB target; single in-process worker, one card at a time.

caveats: Attempt A (unarchived board) is kept as evidence and was not used for the numbers above.
The probe config is a copy under /tmp/slot-probe/home; ~/.hermes/profiles/*/config.yaml and the gateway were not modified or restarted.
Test cards were archived after the run; the slot-test board directory was archived under ~/.hermes/kanban/boards/_archived/.
The in-process worker for assignee coder-d loads the copied coder-d config.yaml/.env; profile-only assets (skills dirs) are not copied.
